source: NARA-prepared layout in DCADS/1996/124.21DP.pdf, 'FY 1996 (DCADS MASTER FILE)'. Positions 1-461 are identical to the FY1990-95 layout; the specific number of offers received, contract-or-order, type of IDC award and commercial-items flag are appended at 462-467. Record length 470 declared in DCADS_TSS.pdf.

notes.record_length: Documented fields end at 467, position 468 is blank, and the final two bytes are the CR and LF delimiters, giving 470.
notes.dollars: Whole dollars, not thousands. The field widens from 9n in the 392-byte era to 11n here, and the parsed totals confirm the reading: FY1989-95 sum to $203-237bn as whole dollars, which joins smoothly onto the 392-byte era's $185-213bn in thousands. The thousands reading would give hundreds of trillions. Through FY1991 the values are whole dollars rounded to the nearest thousand; from FY1992 they are exact to the dollar.
notes.new_fields: This era adds POFPLACE, DLVDATE, CAGE, ESTTIN and PNTTIN ahead of the geography block, which is why every position after POFNM shifts relative to the 392-byte era.
notes.taxpayer_numbers: est_tin and parent_tin are the contractor taxpayer numbers, the only fields NARA ever withholds. They are parsed for completeness and are never used.
notes.lumpsum: Records with an all-zero id_key are DD1057 monthly tallies of below-threshold small purchases rather than individual contracts, carrying no geography at all. See the dcads_392 notes for the measured share.
notes.field_names: The documentation modernises the DUNS mnemonics to ESTKEY, HQKEY and ULTKEY in this era. The positions and meanings are unchanged, so only dod_name differs from the FY1989 layout.
notes.published_series: The is_lumpsum = 0 subset reproduces the published DoD prime-contract award series on its own: FY1995 contract rows sum to $117.55bn against a published figure of about $117bn, and FY1984 gives $133.6bn against about $134bn. The lump-sum dollars are additional to that series, so any comparison against published awards must be run on is_lumpsum = 0 and the lump-sum total reported separately, or it will appear to fail by a factor of nearly two.
notes.geography_is_fips: From FY1984 the geography codes are native FIPS, unlike the DoD-internal sequential codes of the 272-byte era. Verified against known values: state_code is the 2-digit FIPS state (California 06, New York 36, Virginia 51, Texas 48, where the 272 era had 05, 33, 47, 44); county_code is the full 5-digit state-plus-county FIPS (Los Angeles 06037, Cook 17031, Fairfax 51059, Harris 48201); and city_code is the 7-digit FIPS place code. No county crosswalk is needed for this era, which leaves only FY1966-1983 requiring one.
notes.name_case: Name fields are Mixed Case from FY1984 ('California', 'Los Angeles'), where the 272-byte era used upper case ('CALIFORNIA'). Any join on names has to normalise case across the boundary. Abbreviated forms also occur in both eras, for example 'Mass' and 'N CAROLINA', so codes are the reliable join key, not names.
notes.tail_additions: This era is the FY1990-95 record with four fields appended. The single renaming, SDSET to SDBSET at position 431, is a change of mnemonic only.

fields.name: report_no
fields.label: DD350 report number or DD1057 line number

fields.name: id_key
fields.label: Department, contracting office and report number; ten zeros marks a DD1057

fields.name: mod_no
fields.label: Modification, order or other identifying number

fields.name: action_date
fields.label: Date of action, YYMMDD. When the action was OBLIGATED, which is not the reporting period: see month_key. The two agree on fiscal year for about 99% of records; they differ where reporting lagged the obligation.

fields.name: state_name
fields.label: State or country name, truncated to ten characters

fields.name: fsc
fields.label: Federal supply class or service code

fields.name: fsc_description
fields.label: Federal supply class or service description

fields.name: sea_transportation
fields.label: Sea transportation, Y, N or U; this position was competitive characteristics in FY1989

fields.name: competition_indicator
fields.label: Competitive dollar base inclusion, and FPS indicator

fields.name: auth_not_competed
fields.label: Authority for other than full and open competition

fields.name: certified_cost
fields.label: Certificate of current cost or pricing data

fields.name: foreign_product
fields.label: Country code for a foreign product

fields.name: not_small_disadvantaged
fields.label: Reason not awarded to a small disadvantaged business

fields.name: not_small_business
fields.label: Reason not awarded to small business

fields.name: hbcu_setaside
fields.label: Historically black college or minority institution set-aside

fields.name: subcontracting_plan
